title: brassica oleracea var. rupestris
intro: Brassica oleracea var. rupestris, commonly known as sea kale, is a wild, perennial variety of the Brassica oleracea plant family that thrives in coastal areas. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been found to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high content of fiber, vitamins, and minerals. The therapeutic actions of sea kale include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of sea kale include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
